question:
**Fill in the blank: **

Javelin thrower Neeraj Chopra won India's first-ever gold at the World Athletics Championships in ______ in 2023.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Budapest**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Neeraj Chopra won the gold medal in the men’s javelin throw event at the **2023 World Athletics Championships**, held in Budapest, Hungary.
 
• With this victory, Neeraj became the **first Indian athlete to win a gold medal** in the history of the World Athletics Championships.
 
• His winning throw measured **88.17 meters**, achieved in his second attempt during the final.
 
• The World Athletics Championships 2023 took place from **August 19 to August 27, 2023**, in Budapest, Hungary.
 
• Neeraj Chopra's achievement is significant as it adds to his previous accomplishments, including his **gold medal at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics**, further cementing his status as one of India's greatest athletes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Eugene**

 
 
• Eugene, Oregon, USA, hosted the **2022 World Athletics Championships**, making it the first time the event was held in the United States.
 
• Neeraj Chopra won a silver medal at this championship with a throw of 88.13 meters, marking India’s first-ever silver medal at the World Athletics Championships.
 
 
 
• **Tokyo**
 
 
• Tokyo, Japan, was the host city for the **2020 Summer Olympics**, held in 2021 due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• At this event, Neeraj Chopra made history by winning the gold medal in the men’s javelin throw with a throw of 87.58 meters, becoming the first Indian track and field athlete to win an Olympic gold medal.
 
 
 
• **Doha**
 
 
• Doha, Qatar, hosted the **2019 World Athletics Championships** from September 27 to October 6, 2019.
 
• Neeraj Chopra did not participate in this event due to an elbow injury that kept him out of competitive athletics during this period.
